instability.source: Gazebo IMU quaternion converted to body roll/pitch
instability.criterion: non-finite attitude immediately, or abs(roll/pitch) > 60 degrees for 1.0 continuous simulation second

grounding.source: contact sensors bound to every hull collision geometry
grounding.criterion: contact counterpart classified as bathymetry, seabed, ground, or bottom

object_collision.source: contact sensors bound to every hull collision geometry
object_collision.criterion: external hull contact not classified as grounding

allocation_failure.source: normalized command target versus FrozenActuatorBank achieved thrust
allocation_failure.criterion: non-finite output immediately, or relative residual > 20% for ten consecutive 0.1 s control intervals
